$comment: Structural twins recorded by scripts/lint-schema-value-domains.cjs. Each entry has a verdict from a closed set and a reason: replace (a later change replaces the copy with a $ref to the kernel type), merge (the schemas mean one thing; a later change keeps one and makes the others reference it), or alias (a deliberate compatibility name, kept until the next major version). This list only shrinks: fix a twin, then delete its entry. Twins that are distinct concepts belong under distinct_structures in scripts/schema-value-domains.json, not here.
